summary.zh: 检验计划里没被验证的关键假设
summary.en: Test the untested assumptions a plan depends on

description.zh: 对建立在未经验证假设上的计划做压力测试，尤其是爆发式增长模型或周期很长的试点。逐条检查哪些前提必须成立、现有证据够不够、最可能崩在哪一环。适合在投入资源之前冷静核对一遍。
description.en: Stress-tests plans resting on unverified assumptions, especially hockey-stick growth models and long pilots. Checks what must hold, whether evidence exists and where it breaks first. Use before committing resources.
